SIESTA

Accelerate Bench task · Molecular simulation & electronic structure

SIESTA calculates electronic structure with density functional theory.

Task version1.3.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

Each case starts a cold self-consistent calculation, perturbs the geometry and restarts from the computed density matrix.

Correctness

Eigenvalues, forces, stresses, grid fields and density-matrix entries must reproduce the reference within tolerance. The self-consistent calculation must converge.

Timing

The cold calculation and its restart are timed as complete processes. A separate recovery check uses the unmodified application.

Reported runtime-saving reward

First-run rewards on benchmark v1.1, from the data behind paper Table 1, rounded to one decimal. Failed correctness is distinct from a correct result with zero speedup reward.
